from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

def _base_label(sub):
    return Text(sub, font_size=24)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "Sec 2: From Transformation to Matrix: The Standard Matrix",
            [
                'Any linear transformation has a standard matrix.',
                'Columns are images of basis vectors e1 and e2.',
                'For T(x,y)=(2x+y, x-3y), compute T(e1) and T(e2).',
                'T(e1)=(2,1), T(e2)=(1,-3).',
                'Matrix A = [[2,1],[1,-3]] represents T.',
            ],
        )

        def make_plane(top_left, bottom_right, x_range=(-3, 3), y_range=(-3, 3)):
            tl = self.grid[top_left]
            br = self.grid[bottom_right]
            width = abs(br[0] - tl[0]) * 0.9
            height = abs(tl[1] - br[1]) * 0.9
            unit = min(width / (x_range[1] - x_range[0]),
                       height / (y_range[1] - y_range[0]))
            plane = NumberPlane(
                x_range=[x_range[0], x_range[1], 1],
                y_range=[y_range[0], y_range[1], 1],
                x_length=(x_range[1] - x_range[0]) * unit,
                y_length=(y_range[1] - y_range[0]) * unit,
                background_line_style={
                    "stroke_color": "#CCCCCC",
                    "stroke_width": 1,
                    "stroke_opacity": 0.6,
                },
                axis_config={"stroke_color": "#CCCCCC", "stroke_width": 1.5},
            )
            center_x = (tl[0] + br[0]) / 2
            center_y = (tl[1] + br[1]) / 2
            plane.move_to(np.array([center_x, center_y, 0]))
            return plane, unit

        standard_matrix_title = Text(
            "Standard Matrix", font_size=30, color="#00FFFF"
        )
        self.place_at_grid(standard_matrix_title, 'A4', scale_factor=1.0)

        statement = Text(
            "T: R^n -> R^m has an m x n matrix A",
            font_size=22, color="#FFFF99"
        )
        self.place_at_grid(statement, 'B4', scale_factor=1.0)

        plane1, unit1 = make_plane('C1', 'F3', x_range=(-3, 3), y_range=(-3, 3))

        def vec_arrow(plane, vec, color, unit_scale=1.0):
            end = plane.coords_to_point(vec[0], vec[1])
            return Arrow(
                plane.coords_to_point(0, 0), end,
                buff=0, color=color, stroke_width=4,
                max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.2,
            )

        e1_arrow = vec_arrow(plane1, (1, 0), "#4D9EFF")
        e2_arrow = vec_arrow(plane1, (0, 1), "#66FF66")

        e1_label = MathTex("e", "_1", font_size=24).set_color("#4D9EFF")
        e1_label.next_to(e1_arrow.get_end(), DOWN, buff=0.15)
        e2_label = MathTex("e", "_2", font_size=24).set_color("#66FF66")
        e2_label.next_to(e2_arrow.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.15)

        self.play(Write(standard_matrix_title), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(statement), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            Create(plane1),
            run_time=1.0,
        )
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(e1_arrow),
            GrowArrow(e2_arrow),
            run_time=1.0,
        )
        self.play(
            Write(e1_label),
            Write(e2_label),
            run_time=0.6,
        )
        self.wait(0.4)

        columns_statement = Text(
            "Columns of A = images of basis vectors",
            font_size=22, color="#FFFF99"
        )
        self.place_at_grid(columns_statement, 'B4', scale_factor=1.0)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.play(
            Transform(statement, columns_statement),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.play(
            e1_arrow.animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"),
            e2_arrow.animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"),
            run_time=0.3,
        )
        self.play(
            e1_arrow.animate.set_color("#4D9EFF"),
            e2_arrow.animate.set_color("#66FF66"),
            run_time=0.3,
        )

        te1_arrow = vec_arrow(plane1, (2, 1), "#FFA500")
        te2_arrow = vec_arrow(plane1, (1, -3), "#CC66FF")

        te1_label = MathTex("T(e", "_1", ")", font_size=22).set_color("#FFA500")
        te1_label.next_to(te1_arrow.get_end(), UP, buff=0.15)
        te2_label = MathTex("T(e", "_2", ")", font_size=22).set_color("#CC66FF")
        te2_label.next_to(te2_arrow.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.15)

        self.play(
            Transform(e1_arrow.copy(), te1_arrow),
            Transform(e2_arrow.copy(), te2_arrow),
            run_time=1.2,
        )
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(te1_arrow),
            GrowArrow(te2_arrow),
            run_time=1.0,
        )
        self.play(
            Write(te1_label),
            Write(te2_label),
            run_time=0.6,
        )
        self.wait(0.4)

        formula = MathTex(
            "T(x,y)", "=", "(2x+y,", "x-3y)",
            font_size=28,
        ).set_color("#FFFF99")
        self.place_at_grid(formula, 'C4', scale_factor=1.0)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.0)

        comp1 = MathTex(
            "T(e_1)", "=", "(2\\cdot 1 + 0,", "1 - 3\\cdot 0)", "=", "(2,1)",
            font_size=22,
        ).set_color("#99FF99")
        self.place_at_grid(comp1, 'D4', scale_factor=1.0)

        comp2 = MathTex(
            "T(e_2)", "=", "(2\\cdot 0 + 1,", "0 - 3\\cdot 1)", "=", "(1,-3)",
            font_size=22,
        ).set_color("#99FF99")
        self.place_at_grid(comp2, 'E4', scale_factor=1.0)

        self.play(Write(comp1), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(Write(comp2), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.5)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            run_time=0.8,
        )
        self.play(
            te1_arrow.animate.set_color("#FFD580"),
            te2_arrow.animate.set_color("#E0B3FF"),
            run_time=0.3,
        )
        self.play(
            te1_arrow.animate.set_color("#FFA500"),
            te2_arrow.animate.set_color("#CC66FF"),
            run_time=0.3,
        )
        self.play(
            te1_label.animate.set_color("#FFA500"),
            te2_label.animate.set_color("#CC66FF"),
            run_time=0.5,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        self.play(
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            run_time=0.8,
        )

        matrix_bracket = Matrix(
            [[2, 1], [1, -3]],
            left_bracket="[",
            right_bracket="]",
        )
        matrix_bracket.get_entries().set_color("#FFFF99")
        matrix_bracket.get_entries()[0].set_color("#FFA500")
        matrix_bracket.get_entries()[1].set_color("#CC66FF")
        matrix_bracket.get_entries()[2].set_color("#FFA500")
        matrix_bracket.get_entries()[3].set_color("#CC66FF")
        matrix_bracket.scale(1.0)

        a_equals = MathTex("A", "=", font_size=36).set_color("#FFFF99")

        matrix_group = VGroup(a_equals, matrix_bracket).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        self.place_in_area(matrix_group, 'E1', 'F6', scale_factor=0.6)

        self.play(Write(matrix_group), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(
            matrix_group.animate.set_opacity(0.5),
            run_time=0.25,
        )
        self.play(
            matrix_group.animate.set_opacity(1.0),
            run_time=0.25,
        )
        self.play(
            matrix_group.animate.set_opacity(0.5),
            run_time=0.25,
        )
        self.play(
            matrix_group.animate.set_opacity(1.0),
            run_time=0.25,
        )
        self.wait(1.0)
